name: ai-graphic-design
description: AI Graphic Design, powered by Superdesign, creates graphics, slides, presentations and PPT-style decks, and stores AI-generated images in a persistent Moodboard project on an infinite canvas.

interface.longDescription: AI Graphic Design is powered by Superdesign. Create polished posters, social graphics and campaign assets; design coherent slides, presentations, pitch decks and PPT-style decks; or use a persistent Moodboard project to collect AI-generated images and visual references on the Superdesign infinite canvas. Reopen the canvas whenever you want to view or reuse those assets, and create gallery or exhibition-style webpages from selected material when requested.
defaultPrompt: Create three graphic directions for my campaign.
Design a polished presentation/PPT deck from this brief.
Upload these AI images to my Moodboard project and open the canvas.
